# FlutterReleases.com

> Browse every Flutter release — version, Dart SDK, channel, download links, and release notes — in one place. Updated daily.

## What this site provides

- Complete Flutter release history across stable, beta, dev, and main channels (380+ releases)
- Dart SDK version paired with every Flutter version
- Direct download links for macOS (arm64, x64), Linux (x64, arm64), and Windows (x64)
- Release notes and breaking-change links for stable releases
- Data updated daily via GitHub Actions from the official Flutter releases API

## Machine-readable data

- All releases (JSON): https://flutterreleases.com/releases.json
- RSS feed (stable + beta, newest 50): https://flutterreleases.com/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://flutterreleases.com/sitemap.xml

## JSON schema (per release item in releases.json)

```json
{
  "version": "3.44.0",
  "channel": "stable",
  "release_type": "release",
  "released": "2026-05-18",
  "dart_version": "3.7.0",
  "framework_revision": "abc123...",
  "engine_revision": "def456...",
  "git_tag": "3.44.0",
  "requires": {
    "xcode": "15",
    "android_sdk": "34"
  },
  "platforms": {
    "macos_arm64": "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/...",
    "macos_x64": "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/...",
    "linux_x64": "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/...",
    "windows_x64": "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/..."
  },
  "release_notes": {
    "base": "https://docs.flutter.dev/release/release-notes/release-notes-3.44.0",
    "summary": "...",
    "highlights": [],
    "breaking_changes": [],
    "deprecations": []
  },
  "ref_url": "https://github.com/flutter/flutter/releases/tag/3.44.0",
  "verified": true
}
```

## Useful queries on releases.json

To get the latest stable release:
```js
const data = await fetch('https://flutterreleases.com/releases.json').then(r => r.json());
const items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items;
const latestStable = items.find(r => r.channel === 'stable');
```

To get all stable releases:
```js
const stable = items.filter(r => r.channel === 'stable');
```

To look up Dart SDK version for a Flutter version:
```js
const release = items.find(r => r.version === '3.44.0');
console.log(release.dart_version); // "3.7.0"
```
